title: Latent Visual Contrastive Reasoning with Multi-Branch Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2610.36809v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models have made substantial progress in visual question answering, but complex visual reasoning often requires locating and comparing multiple pieces of question-relevant visual evidence. Existing methods that move intermediate reasoning into the visual latent space usually follow a single linear reasoning trajectory, which can be limiting when multiple visual hypotheses or competing evidence regions are relevant. We propose Latent Visual Contrastive Reasoning, a branch-aware latent reasoning framework that generates multiple question-conditioned latent visual branches as soft hypotheses over image tokens. To train these branches, our method uses bounding-box evidence annotations to build target evidence representations and introduces a soft contrastive branch-evidence alignment objective. This objective encourages evidence-relevant branches to align with annotated visual regions while contrasting them agains

translated_title: 基于多分支探索的潜在视觉对比推理
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型在视觉问答方面取得了长足进步，但复杂的视觉推理往往需要定位并比较多条与问题相关的视觉证据。现有方法将中间推理过程迁移到视觉潜在空间中，但通常遵循单一的线性推理轨迹，当涉及多个视觉假设或相互竞争的证据区域时，这种方式存在局限。我们提出了潜在视觉对比推理，这是一种分支感知的潜在推理框架，可生成多个以问题为条件的潜在视觉分支，作为图像词元之上的软假设。为训练这些分支，我们的方法利用边界框证据标注构建目标证据表示，并引入了软对比的分支-证据对齐目标。该目标促使与证据相关的分支与标注的视觉区域对齐，同时将其与其他分支进行对比……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种分支感知的潜在视觉推理框架，通过生成多个问题条件的潜在视觉分支，并利用边界框证据标注进行软对比的分支-证据对齐训练，突破单一线性推理轨迹的局限，提升复杂视觉推理能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes a branch-aware latent visual reasoning framework that generates multiple question-conditioned latent visual branches and trains them with a soft contrastive branch-evidence alignment objective using bounding-box evidence annotations, overcoming the limitation of single linear reasoning trajectories.
